text:
Maria: Morning! WFH desk update — my USB mic knocked over my fern and knocked coffee onto the keyboard. :scream: anyone else living dangerously?
Alex: Oof. Pics? :eyes:
Maria: https://imgur.com/example1.jpg (don’t click if you hate plants)
Jamal: Yikes. Keyboard salvageable? Quick tip: unplug and let it dry 24-48h. Do NOT power it on.
Sophie: Try fan + towel, then bag with silica gel if you have. Also, if your wifi seems slow after a spill, try restarting the router.
Maria: Router seemed fine but I had small ping spikes. Did a quick restart:
```
sudo systemctl restart NetworkManager
```
Maria: That fixed it. Also moved the mic to a boom arm. Feels way less risky.
Alex: Boom arm pics please. Also jealous of the lamp.
Maria: https://imgur.com/example2.jpg
Sophie: :thumbsup: nice setup. Also we should do a poll — who still uses laptop camera + ring light vs proper webcam?
Jamal: webcam + crappy lighting = me.
Alex: laptop cam + quilt diffuser :D
Maria: webcam, but mic is new so still learning placement.
NetBot: Reminder: virtual lunch at 12pm today in #random :salad:
Sophie: I'll bring virtual cookies :cookie:
Alex: @Maria glad coffee didn't brick anything. :relieved:
Maria: Thanks all. Also if anyone needs spare keys/keyboard I have a spare full-size at office (drop by) — or I can ship. :package:
